behavior_constraints: --ingest-id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*$ and be 1..128 chars; otherwise exit 2 with exact stderr 'ingest: --ingest-id: invalid (must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:-]*$, 1..128 chars)'
When --ingest-id is absent, manifest ingest_id is JSON null (not empty string)
--ingest-id alone (without --out-parquet-manifest) is a byte-for-byte no-op for --output, --rejects, --state-out, --audit-log, --audit-log-digest
When neither new flag is passed, behavior is byte-for-byte identical to the strict-rates feature

--out-parquet-manifest writes pretty-printed JSON (2-space indent, trailing newline) with top-level keys in exact order: schema_version, ingest_id, run_index, rates_digest, input_shards, outputs, window
run_index = priorState.run_index + 1 when --state-in points to existing valid state; otherwise 1 (cold start or missing file)
rates_digest is 64-char lowercase hex, always present (never null)
input_shards array sorted by basename ASCII-ascending; each record has keys in order: shard, sha256, bytes, events_total, events_accepted
events_total counts non-blank lines; events_accepted counts lines whose final audit-bucket is accepted (late/invalid/duplicate/unresolved_chargeback excluded)
entities.summary: Add an optional per-run ingest manifest (--out-parquet-manifest) with --ingest-id label and optional --manifest-signature sidecar, emitting deterministic pretty-printed JSON describing the run without altering existing output bytes.

instruction_head:
## Ingest Manifest (`--out-parquet-manifest` + `--ingest-id`)

Add a new user-visible capability — a per-run **ingest manifest** — without changing any of the output bytes produced by existing flags. Two new flags are introduced and work in combination:

- `--ingest-id <string>`: an optional, user-supplied label for the run.
- `--out-parquet-manifest <path>`: an optional path; when set, the CLI writes a JSON manifest describing the run.
